messages.snippet: Dear all, The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable from 22:00 on Saturday 20 Sep
messages.subject: [IT] Scheduled DMS maintenance - Saturday 20 September
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable from 22:00 on Saturday 20 September until approximately 02:00 on Sunday 21 September for scheduled maintenance and patching. Please save and close all open documents before this window. Email will not be affected.

If you have any urgent out-of-hours requirements please contact the helpdesk on ext. 4000.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
